opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. United States v. American Sheet & Tin Plate Co., 301 U. S. 402; United States v. United States Smelting Co., 339 U. S. 186.

Mr. Justice Minton took no part in the consideration or decision of. this case.
